headline: Lodging houses at 16 and 18 Claremont Street approved for Broadview Holdings LLC.
summary: The applicant's attorney said the two buildings will have 27 beds, 12 at 16 Claremont and 15 at 18 Claremont. The attorney said 16 Claremont was once a Clark University dormitory, and 18 will be renovated inside. The applicant's company, Maverick Property Services, LLC, will manage the lodging houses, with an onsite manager. Separately, the Icy Gaming Mart Restaurant application was continued to December 3rd at 10:00 a.m., and the applicant must attend in person.
decisions: Approved lodging house licenses for Broadview Holdings LLC at 16 and 18 Claremont Street, 2-0.
Continued the Icy Gaming Mart Restaurant application to December 3rd at 10:00 a.m., with the applicant required to attend in person, 2-0.
discussion: Lodging house security: The commission asked where security monitors would be. The applicant said each building has eight cameras recorded on its own DVR, viewable from one monitor in the manager's office.
Icy Gaming Mart application: The commission said the issue was very serious and needed an in-person discussion, because the place had a license revoked earlier.
Two-member board: Two of three commissioners were present, so applicants could ask to have their case continued to a new date.
